litematica_turbo.message.out_of_memory: [Litematica Turbo] This schematic is too big for the memory Minecraft has (%s MB), so it was not loaded. Give Minecraft more memory or use a smaller schematic.
litematica_turbo.message.storage_off: [Litematica Turbo] Compact schematic storage hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. Schematics are stored the normal Litematica way.
litematica_turbo.message.batch_off: [Litematica Turbo] Batch drawing hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. The schematic is drawn piece by piece, as in normal Litematica.
litematica_turbo.message.batch_paused: [Litematica Turbo] Batch drawing is paused while shaders from %s are on, because they draw the schematic differently. The schematic is drawn piece by piece, as in normal Litematica, and batch drawing comes back when the shaders are off.
litematica_turbo.message.copy_off: [Litematica Turbo] Fast placement copying hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. Placements are copied the normal Litematica way.
litematica_turbo.message.far_off: [Litematica Turbo] Less detail far away hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. Every outline is drawn, as in normal Litematica.
litematica_turbo.message.build_dropped: [Litematica Turbo] A schematic chunk could not be built (%s). That build was dropped and the chunk is built again; the details are in the game log.
litematica_turbo.message.complete_off: [Litematica Turbo] The complete copy while moving hit an error (%s) and is off for this session. A moved placement shows the normal old pieces, as before.
